executive_summary: Custom Designs TX is a premium home technology integration company serving McAllen and the Rio Grande Valley. Their website is comprehensive: 78 pages covering 20 service categories across 7 RGV communities with 36 geo-targeted blog posts. Technical SEO is solid with valid SSL, 78-URL sitemap, LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema, clean Open Graph tags, and Next.js on Vercel. Key gaps: missing H1 tag on homepage, only 1/4 security headers (HSTS only), no explicit AI crawler rules in robots.txt. Google Business Profile is verified. Facebook presence is active via Graph API. Primary opportunities: implement AI crawler access, add security headers, build FAQ schema, expand backlink profile beyond directories, and launch Instagram for visual project showcases. With these fixes, they can dominate local search for high-intent home technology queries across the RGV.

attack_vectors: Content moat: 36 blog posts already live. None of the top 5 competitors have more than 5. Double down on geo-specific content.
Category breadth: Only Custom Designs spans security + AV + smart home + lighting. Competitors are single-category. Own 'whole home technology' positioning.
Cinematic landing pages: 4 magazine-style pages. Unique visual differentiator in a market of text-only competitor sites.
Review gap: Rio Grande Security has 200+ reviews in security. Close the gap in the security vertical specifically.
Instagram: AV Integration Pro has strong Instagram. Custom Designs has none. Visual project showcases would be powerful.
